Its portfolio includes residential kit homes, commercial and industrial buildings, hospitals, schools, apartment blocks, and office and retail fit-outs. NIUGINI BUILDERS also offers civil works, steel fabrication, site preparation, renovation and remodeling, building maintenance, and specialist works for government and donor aid agencies. The organization is committed to quality, reliability, and long-term client partnerships across diverse construction environments. Role Description This is a full-time remote role for a Senior Accountant at NIUGINI BUILDERS. The Senior Accountant will oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including managing general ledger entries, preparing financial statements, and maintaining accurate records of expenses, revenues, and project-related costs. The role includes monitoring budgets, performing variance analyses, and supporting project managers with financial reporting and cost control. The Senior Accountant will handle accounts payable and receivable, reconcile bank and balance sheet accounts, and ensure timely completion of month-end and year-end closing activities. The individual will also support audits, implement and refine internal controls, ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards and regulations, and provide financial insights to leadership to support strategic decision-making. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong core accounting skills, including general ledger management, financial statement preparation, reconciliations, and month-end/year-end closing. Candidates should possess financial analysis and reporting skills, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and cost control for projects. Candidates should possess proficiency with accounting software and spreadsheets, as well as the ability to work with digital tools in a remote environment. Candidates should possess knowledge of tax regulations, compliance requirements, internal controls, and audit support practices. Candidates should possess excellent attention to detail, organization, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines. Candidates should possess strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with project teams, management, and external stakeholders. Relevant experience in construction, engineering, or project-based accounting environments is highly beneficial. A bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is required; professional certifications (such as CPA or equivalent) are an advantage. Demonstrated ability to work independently in a remote setting with a high level of integrity and confidentiality is essential.
